articleTitle: How to Stop Someone From Staring at You (When You're Autistic)
imageHeadline: Set Boundaries Around Staring Without the Confrontation
imageSubtext: Practical scripts for autistic people navigating unwanted attention
pinTitle: How to Stop Someone Staring at You (Autistic-Friendly Boundary Scripts)
pinDescription: Unwanted staring in class or public spaces can be anxiety-inducing, and confronting it directly feels risky. This guide offers specific, low-escalation language and strategies to address staring while protecting yourself from misinterpretation.
